cost.title: Serverless is estimated to cost more than ECH for this fleet
cost.evidence: ECH billed cost in K360 is $73,823/mo. Serverless is Search $76,608/mo = $76,608/mo.
cost.action: Do not position this move as a cost saving. Check the estimator inputs, and compare on operations and scale instead of price.

cost.title: Shift aged data to the frozen tier
cost.evidence: 24.6 TB stored; frozen = 0.0% of capacity ECU; hot = 91.8%
cost.action: ILM: hot 7–30 d → frozen (searchable snapshots) for retention. Frozen is typically 5–10× cheaper per GB than hot.

cost.title: Upgrade to unlock LogsDB / TSDS storage savings
cost.action: LogsDB index mode (8.17+/9.x) and TSDS reduce logs/metrics storage ~50–65%; pair with synthetic _source.

cost.title: Review 1 near-idle deployment(s)
cost.action: Confirm ownership; decommission or snapshot-and-delete if unused.

notes: Sized 10 ECH deployments with a bill from 2026-08-18 through 2026-11-15 (90 days). 0 deployments had no bill in that window. Their last stored snapshot, 0 GB, is not carried into the sizing.

Ingest GB/day is the write-index sum of index.primaries.bulk.est_bytes_per_day from the Elasticsearch diagnostic bundle. Retention is the size-weighted ILM delete age on local primary store, or an explicit 30-day assumption for store without a delete policy or data-stream retention, rounded up to a whole month for the estimator. Those two are summed by solution and by region. Search disk and the Search ingest-share denominator use diagnostic local store only; K360 stored sizes are excluded from the diagnostic estimate. Search query rates use exact-window Cloud Tracker index telemetry. ECH ECU stays the K360 bill.
ECU/mo on the sizing row is 2026-10 billing for those deployments, the last complete month.
100% of local store has no delete policy or data-stream retention. That share uses the 30-day assumed default, not an observed retention duration.

27 indices took bulk writes and have no ingest rate: 9,570 GB of store, 33.4% of local store (dep-05 (9,016 GB), dep-08 (489 GB), dep-09 (57 GB), dep-01 (7 GB), dep-03 (0 GB)). They are not a data stream, a write alias, or an ILM rollover, or their write index has no write phase. Their ingest is not in bulk GB/day, so the estimate can sit below the real rate.
search retention measures 1.0 months. The estimate is a one-year estimate, so 12 is written to the estimator.
